NSCameraUsageDescription: Escape Challenge uses the camera so you can take a photo as proof when completing a task.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Escape Challenge needs access to your photo library so you can attach a photo as proof when completing a task.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Escape Challenge saves photos you select to your library.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Escape Challenge does not use the microphone.
NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Escape Challenge sends notifications to keep you updated on tasks and approvals.
